fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects email exfiltration via powershell cmdlets
fields.name: Email Exifiltration Via Powershell
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\powershell.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\pwsh.exe") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "Add-PSSnapin" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "Get-Recipient" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "-ExpandProperty" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "EmailAddresses" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "SmtpAddress" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "-hidetableheaders")))
